---
mode: agent
---

Buat atau rapikan satu halaman frontend di obx_site dengan pola DataTable + DataDialog, validasi zod, toast error, dan mobile-friendly behavior.

Constraints:
- use existing UI patterns in obx_site/src/uix
- use clientApi and getErrorMessage
- align page behavior with obx_docs/blueprint/{KODE}/README.md
- update related docs in obx_docs/blueprint/{KODE}/README.md and obx_docs/guide/{KODE}.md when behavior changes
- keep changes scoped to one page
- validate with typecheck after changes

Format output:
Scope: {halaman frontend}
Changes: {file yang berubah}
Validation: {command} -> {hasil}
Notes: {blocker atau saran}
